popCulture.title: Phoebe (moon)
popCulture.description: Saturn's irregular outer moon took the Titaness' name — Phoebe as a dark captured world far beyond the rings.

popCulture.title: Phoebe (Titaness)
popCulture.description: Bright Phoebe endures as grandmother of Apollo and Artemis — the prophetic Titaness in Leto's line.
